# Loyalty Dashboard

## Summary
The member's home view of their standing: who they are to the program,
the numbers that matter (balance, lifetime), what just happened, and what
is about to expire. Shared-realm component at
`components/loyalty-dashboard.gts`. One component so every loyalty app's
home screen carries the same reading order — identity, standing,
movement, urgency, actions.

## API
- `@account` — a Loyalty Account card
- `@tier` — the account's resolved rung; the consumer owns its ladder, so it resolves once: `tierOption(MyTierField, account.tier)`
- `@transactions` — recent ledger rows, newest first, already queried and sliced by the consumer
- `@expiringPoints` / `@expiringOn` — the expiry callout, precomputed by the consumer (FIFO expiry math is the program's business)
- `:actions` block — the consumer's calls to action (view rewards, upgrade, renew)

## Example
In use by the linked Club Membership app's member home.

## Non-goals
The dashboard renders what it is handed and never counts, sums or expires
anything itself — the ledger query, the balance and the expiry math all
belong to the program (see the Credit Points spec). Rewards browsing is a
catalog surface, not a dashboard panel; it hangs off the `:actions`
block.
